title: F850GS Adventure (Dark Edition)
description: Within the Adventure Tourer segment, the BMW Motorrad F850GS Adventure (Dark Edition) is engineered for uncompromised trans-continental exploration. Powered by a 850cc engine generating 89 HP and 73 Nm of torque against a curb weight of 193 kg, it delivers predictable, roll-on throttle response across its usable powerband. The cockpit is configured with an Aggressive Forward Tuck stance and a commanding 855mm perch delivering excellent ground clearance and expansive sightlines, prioritizing aerodynamic tuck and front-end circuit precision over casual urban commuting.
